title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 17 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Monday, November 2, and Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Monday, November 2, and Tuesday, November 3, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

MATA, GABRIEL

MATA, GABRIEL was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 9:51 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of criminal trespass on a habitation, shelter, superfund site or infrastructure, a Class A misdemeanor; theft of property valued at less than $100, a Class C misdemeanor; and criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set on any of the charges at the time of booking.

GONZALEZ, ARTURO, JR was arrested on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 3:28 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $750 or more but less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

Bond was set at $3,000 on each charge.
